Slapdud is a rather peculiar orc shaman. It's rare to see him in his shamanic robes, and he always accompanies the boys whenever there is a fight, as he prefers to fight hand-to-hand and feel the crushing of bones with his enormous staff, which he uses like a hammer. Despite that, he knows the basic Da Big Waaagh spells. But he always prefers to smash things with his staff.
Zguk is an orc who worships Gork above all else. He is always fighting with Mguk to prove that ‘Gork is da best’.
Mguk is an orc who worships Mork above all else. He is always fighting with Zguk to prove that ‘Mork is da best’.

An orc who calls himself an inventor, but has yet to invent anything that doesn't explode or kill anyone who tries to use it. He believes that the secret to making everything work is based on the paint you use to cover it. But so far it has not worked.

The orc with the worst sense in the world. Anything horrible to a normal person (or even other orcs) is worthy of his admiration. If it were up to him, they'd be 'those sour fruits from da palm trees' in the Tilean kitchen, sculptures would be objects stuck to walls or upside down, and he would probably even promote a more 'Brutal-ist' architecture.

A vulgar orc who tends to isolate himself from the crowd whenever he can, committing mischief on his own. When it comes to allocating the most valuable loot, nobody thinks about him. But luckily, he tricks some goblins into being his helpers when it comes to committing villainy outside the control of the other members of the boys.
‘ERE WUZ SUM ZOGGIN’ FINGZ ABOUT BAGDUD, BUT DEY ENT MAKE SENSE. ALL YER GITS NEED TA KNOW IZ BAGDUD IZ DA BEST AN’ BADDEST!!!

Morglum Necksnapper is the Black Orc Вайнабос of the Necksnapper Tribe. Originating from the Chaos Dwarf plains in the east. Most Orcs are loud and quarrelsome, but Black Orcs are quiet and stern. This is especially true of Morglum, who appears to be almost entirely fearless. Morglum is renowned for his short battle cries and terse tactical observations.

Oglok the 'Orrible is a massive Orc Big Boss who acts as Morglum Necksnapper's second-in-command. Oglok's tribe lived in the Badlands and was defeated by Morglum’s Black Orcs. Oglok was so impressed by the Black Orc leader that he decided to ally with Morglum. Since then, he has fought in many battles alongside the Black Orcs, leading his boys against humies and stunties. Oglok is a seasoned Orc veteran and bears many battle scars. His powers of leadership are second only to Morglum himself.

Gazak has been part of the Necksnapper Tribe since the beginning. He is a devout follower of his Вайнабос, Morglum, and has seen his fair share of combat, subjugating many tribes and killing foes over the years.

An angry and ferocious fighter covered in white skull paint. Skulgud loves beheading his enemies. He’s often the first to clash into enemy lines to decapitate and collect as many grisly trophies as he can.

Dakkgad was once a slave of the Dawi-Zharr. When he was being transported to another work camp, the slave caravan came under attack. Luckily for Dakkgad, it was fellow Greenskins that came to kill the Chaos Dwarfs. The warband led by Morglum offered the Black Orc a place amongst his ranks if he swore loyalty. Dakkgad is now a renowned vanguard leader in the great horde, overwhelming any foe with his great strength.
Cunningly brutal, this Big ‘Un is the head of the horde’s scouting party. Agdrut likes his position, for it allows him to lead his boys into battle as soon as possible.

Former leader of the Purple Chewa tribe, Skorbad, chose to follow Morglum after a one-sided defeat. He was swallowed by the mighty Шыяломы horde and rode to the west, joining in the battle of Death Pass.

Ugfang was stuck inside a system of caves for a long time, but he survived. It is said some Night Goblin slaves found him when scouting new tunnel ways in the World’s Edge Mountains. They encountered a big, feral-looking Orc that killed many of their mates before they cunningly decided to bomb him with their special shroom bombs. Once on the surface, Ugfang was beaten into submission and returned to his senses.

This heavy-clad ork is good at punching and also good at receiving punches. A lot of orcs wonder what would happen if he punched himself. So Skarglud brought it to the test, and to his surprise, his punches did little to no damage. Furious with this discovery, he keeps punching himself to feel any pain. The sight of this made most of Skarglud’s boys afraid of their boss, seeing such powerful blows do nothing that they obey without question. This orc must be one of da toughest in the camp.

The Great Shaman of the Necksnapper tribe has the important task of supporting da boyz with “spellz and stuffs” so that they can fight ‘arder while the stunties and humies can’t run away from the battle.

Odguth is a hulking Black Orc, and when he’s on the warpath his armour and weapons clank like an Imperial soup kitchen. Once the fighting is done, Odguth scours the battlefield in search of shiny weapons to add to his collection. He is followed by a small band of soot-blackened goblins who hammer the spoils onto his already monstrous choppa. The weapon is an abominable amalgamation of blades and metalwork from across the Old World, crudely beaten, riveted, and strapped together into one colossal, jagged edge.

Orlob has perfected a gruesome technique for tearing off a foe’s jaw in a single, swift motion. He’ll ram his entire hand into an Orc’s mouth, or just a finger, if it’s a ‘umie, and with one powerful downward yank, he rips the jaw clean away. This eccentric way of fighting has won him many duels, and teef.

Wherever Grubzza goes, fire is never far behind. He is the bane of every forest in the Old World, a frenzied figure seen dancing and hollering amidst the burning woods, hated equally by Wood Elf and Beastman alike. When night falls and the flames roar around him, Grubzza can often be heard bellowing at the moon, howling and shrieking in the hope that Morrslieb itself might look down and take notice.
Even the oldest Bosses do not know the name of this Black Orc. Rippa Ov Armz, unsurprisingly, got his moniker from tearing off the arms of his still-breathing opponents.

Kazbad has proven his skill when he fought a towering Ogre one-on-one. With the Ogre’s defeat, Kazbad assumed the title of Mawgouger for both disrespecting the Big Maw and striking the Ogre’s maw so hard his head almost did a full spin.

This young Big Un has risen through the ranks, defeating most of his tribesmen with ease. While he is still relatively young and inexperienced, most of the other Big Uns don’t take him that seriously. But Azgor is eager to prove that, in time, he can surely beat anyone.

Skultrag loves to lop off heads of stunties. He finds them cowardly, for when scrap time is there, they cower behind their big stone walls instead of fighting Skulotrag. They also fight with boomsticks from range, the cowards. That's why Skulotrag rides a boar, so the stunties cannot escape.

A cruel and harsh leader, not many would dare to challenge Ugrok for his leadership. The ones that do are quick to find their heads rolling from their shoulders. Having enormous strength, Ugrok can pierce the hardest of steel and causes his foes to tremble at his sight. Some boys even say Ugrok would be able to beat a Giant in a duel.

Second in command. Snorko One-Finger is a vicious fighter who occupies himself with keeping the boys in check. Wearing his heavy plate armour, Snorko is often seen on the frontline, smashing the heads of enemies with blows so powerful they could shatter rocks.

Snog lives for the Waaagh! Smashing and crushing fings is all he cares about. This veteran of the Чэрапаломы tribe is a horrifying foe to encounter on the battlefield, using unorthodox ways of fighting to crush his foes.

Olgork always carries his bow and arrers. He is often ridiculed for using such a cowardly weapon. Nonetheless, Olgork kills as efficiently as any Big Boss. Not very efficient at aiming, but Olgork pulls the bowstring with so much strength that his targets often explode into puddles of blood.
Zummork Skrap-heaf is a tough fighter and a self-proclaimed poet. He is rather thick but has a way with words like no other Orc. Rhyming about the WAAAGH! before every scrap and his killing blows.

Long ago, Molg was part of the great WAAAGH! led by Grom the Paunch. After days at sea battling the Asur, Molg’s ship sank to the depths. Washing up on the coast of Bretonnia, Molg found himself joining the Чэрапаломы, shifting his allegiance and making himself useful again.

Gakroz is an Orc Great Shaman and wields powerful magic of Gork (or Mork?). He is one of the few to sometimes oppose Ugrok's decisions and can get away with it. Destructive spells of da Big Waaagh! cast by Gakroz usually don’t leave any trace of the poor gits that dared to face him in battle.

Gazagkh is the Boss of Boar Boys, leading his vanguard headlong into the fray. Originally, Gazagkh fought for a different tribe, but his Boss’ defeat caused Gazagkh and his band of Orcs to seek worthy fights elsewhere. Now, Gazakgh has found his true purpose in raiding the caravans looking to cross Axe Bite Pass.
Once upon a time Gutlob once caused such a massacre in the valley that the mountain slopes were flowing with blood and gore. The End.
Big Boss of Boar Boys, enjoys trampling his enemies to the point his beloved war boar is drenched with blood. No, that does not make it run any faster.
Do not cross this Orc Shaman, he is stark raving mad. Seriously, do not even try it. All it takes is one mad glance of Duzzrag’s crazy eyes for the nearby Boys to disperse in great haste.
Kugg takes great pleasure in collecting and cleaning the skulls of his foes. It is not long after these grisly trophies adorn his war helmet.

This bulky Black Orc Boss possesses surprising reflexes and agility for his size. Local Boyz are slightly suspicious of such dexterous fighting style – They suspect it is the work of Cluzz Mad Eye and his shady concoctions.

While Snik’s cunning far outshines that of its kin, he is infamous for two traits alone: a disturbing obsession with marshes and the eye-watering stench that comes from wallowing for days in mud and bogs. His intimate knowledge of the mires proved instrumental in Gutlob Blood Riva’s crushing victory over the Bretonnians as his Goblins emerged from nowhere, stabbing at horses from beneath. Now, Snik’s Goblins terrorize the fens, preying upon the few peasants foolish enough to brave the muck - though the great gobbo stubbornly refuses to venture far from the comforting, albeit rancid, marshland he prowls.

Razzglit, an Orc Shaman, wields the magic of Da Big Waaagh! While invoking hexes and curses to debilitate the foe and empowering his bigger kin in battle, Snazznat is still a cunning leader who controls crucial manoeuvres on the battlefield.

With his severe lack of intelligence and unrivalled strength, Dorkork often finds himself winning the most desperate of battles, killing as many of his boys as enemies. Very few can claim to be dumber than Dorkork, but with Gork’s blessing, he doesn’t need to think about losing or even think at all!

Snagla Grobspit is a legendary goblin lord famous for driving the humans out of the Драквальд forest and for being the leader of the Чырвоны Яд clan. Famous for his spider breeding and the massive Arachnaroc spider lairs. His chilling battle screech is said to be unrivaled among goblins.

Glartstik Kunnintongue is one of the most loyal goblins in Snagla Grobspit’s tribe. Always ready to shed human blood alongside him. His devotion to Snagla is seen as a sycophancy by the rest of the goblins.

Globnank Shroomspore is a shaman of the Чырвоны Яд tribe. Before a fight, he has a habit of ingesting venom from a type of spider called Purple Skullbacks. The toxins, which have stupefying effects, make him immune to pain and enhance his magical abilities, at the cost of temporarily driving him insane while the effects last.

Zonkzag Snottoof is one of the main breeders of black pit spiders. He is the one who oversees the growth and development of the new spiders and selects those that are suitable to be mounted by their peers.
Grulsnag Cankersniffa is a famed spider rider of the Чырвоны Яд clan. Equal parts stealthy and venomous, he inspires confidence among the other riders who ride alongside him.

Stiznik Hackbagz is the most important night goblin in the small community of night goblins that inhabit the Чорная Яма. He and his ilk make their living by trading with the forest goblins and cooperating with them to defend their part of the Драквальд forest.

Rakzag Cacklestikka is one of the most successful goblin ambushers the Драквальд forest has ever seen. He is primarily responsible for ensuring that no scouting party gets too close to the cesspool. If they do, he makes sure none can tell.

Grulwonk Dirtnose is the forest goblin shaman in charge of creating and overseeing the production of all the poisons that the other goblins will use against their enemies. Because of this, he is a highly respected and prestigious goblin within the Чорная Яма.

Naffglat Slugcrawla is a nasty creature even by other goblin standards. He's slippery, kleptomanic, and irritating. In battle, there are always other goblins fighting alongside him, but they only do it to see if they can kill him once and for all.
Ignok Danksplatta is the most famous archer in all of Чорная Яма. And also one of the goblins who is quickest to flee when things start to go wrong.

Grulnat Poisongobba is one of the goblin shamans of the Чорная Яма. He is often seen collecting the bones of the unfortunate people who die in the Драквальд forest to experiment on them in his little rituals.
Nazrunk Gunkpokkitz is responsible for guarding the entrance to the great Arachnarok Spiders' burrows. A position of great prestige, but also dangerous.

Gnashrak Gloomguzzla can boast of being one of the richest goblins in the Old World. Such is the fame of his wealth that numerous creatures from every corner of the world flock to him for the chance to serve him in exchange for a fraction of that wealth. And Gnashrak never turns down expendable volunteers to use as a wall of meat for his enemies.

Kakglat Deathgutz is one of the main shamans of the Крывавыя Дзіды tribe. He often ventures into Сыльванія alone, taking advantage of his proximity to try to steal something shiny or something to put into his cauldron of potions; from herbs to remains of any animal… or thing.

Snufflak Wolfbita is a skilled rider who rides the largest and strongest wolf available in the Крывавыя Дзіды clan.The wolf he rides has bitten him on more than one occasion, but Snufflak doesn't seem to mind and is always willing to try to mount him again in the hope that another bite won't tear off his reins arm.

Kakrunk Venommullet is the most expendable shaman in the Крывавыя Дзіды tribe. That's why instead of using him as a shaman, he's used as an emissary to other greenskin tribes. They don't know him, so he can pass himself off as a real shaman and command a modicum of respect from the other greenskins.
Raknank Wolfsmakka is one of the Крывавыя Дзіды clan's scouts. His discretion and stealth make him the ideal candidate to infiltrate the villages and camps that the tribe will later raid.

Stizglops Gloomfinga was a goblin who was long held in slavery by the Chaos Dwarves. It is unknown how he managed to escape, but he was able to find refuge in the Worlds Edge Mountains living as a tracker for the Крывавыя Дзіды clan.

Dagzat Hackcrawla is the goblin archer most highly regarded by the Крывавыя Дзіды clan. It's not because he's the most accurate at shooting; his shots are far from perfect. But he's the fastest at reloading his quiver and therefore the one who fires the most arrows per minute. Apparently, one saves valuable time by shooting without aiming.

Stories tell of a time when Glartsnik Siksack was stationed at a small outpost where the other goblins would mock him, steal from him, and even play practical jokes on him that nearly cost him his life at the hands of a hungry squig. Glartsnik decided to take revenge by impaling the rest of his group on his spear. The brutality of his actions made Gnashrak think he would be a valuable addition to their ranks if he used that same fury on his enemies.

Borguk Da Stabbiest is a fierce goblin who is renowned for, well, stabbing things. Borguk got his position by stabbing the Clan Chief, Snarg, and then feeding his corpse to the squigs. Now, Borguk is the Chief of the Dripping Dagger Clan, serving Gnashrak Gloomguzzler until he can stab him in the back.

Shnozz ‘Eavy Toe is not very remarkable at all. In fact the only reason Shnozz has been leading a warband for Borguk is due to Shnozz being loyal. Shnozz is more cunningly brutal than his goblin brethren who are brutally cunning.

Nothing excites Greebitz more than the sight of teeth. Not just orc or goblin teeth, but any beings' teeth. The current collection of teeth that Greebitz owns is in the thousands, most from humans, but ranging all the way from Dwarfs, Trolls, Arachnarok Spiders, and even a tooth of a long dead Grail Knight.

Da Evil Heg has made a name across the Empire, but not like most warlords of the Night Goblins. Instead this warlord is a renowned schemer. Da Evil Heg uses vile concoctions, dreaded brews, and haggard colours to sow dissent into the realms of man. It is rumored that Da Evil Heg has delved into the arts of “Artistry,” something that no Greenskin even has the concept of.

One of the cleverest and most sneaky Goblins, Sly Sweaty Bolloks has served under many warlords across the ages. Indeed, the little schemer has served under Skarsnik, the warlord of Eight Peaks, and even the long dead Grom the Paunch as one of his chief warlords. It's rumored that he may be the oldest goblin in existence, but there are none alive to back up that claim.

Despite having equipment on par with a normal goblin, Skagzat Dirtgobbla prefers not to carry weapons at all. Although he does carry them to begin with, he prefers to throw them at the enemy and then jump on them and use his sharp teeth to hurt the opponent. Such is his thirst for blood.

Skarglops Webspite is seen visiting forest goblins more often than he is in his own clan. He has spent so much time among them that he seems more comfortable with spiders than with the wolves or squigs of the Крывавыя Дзіды clan. He may have grown up in the wrong tribe, but that doesn't make him any less willing to fight for it.

Gitnibz Cackletongue is a shaman who consciously abuses mushrooms and other shamanic substances, causing him to constantly wander into a state of 'prophetic' madness. He keeps proclaiming crazy things like 'The End of Times', 'The Age of the God of Mankind', 'Noisy fire-powered chariots' and even ‘Boxes with unpainted toy boys’. Obviously, nobody believes him, but the rest of the goblins find this nonsense entertaining.

Kap’n Snozzsnik Skumclaw is the leader of the goblin tribe known as the Рашкрадальнікі, which is located on the northwestern coast of Нордлянд, somewhere between Wrecker's Point and Manann’s Teeth. Not much is known about him or his way of running the clan (which should be no different than other goblins). But the few times he has been seen, he has been seen patrolling the region on the back of a huge wolf.

Zonkgaz Badguzzla is one of the goblins who watches over the Рашкрадальнікі clan's lair to make sure no souls come near. If they aren't deterred by the fierce, pointed rocks in the bay, the stranded ships, the corpses, or the chilling screams, he makes sure they get speared in the chest.

Spiznogg Badspite has a little personal habit. He remembers very well the enemies he has killed in his ambushes, and after finishing the ambush, he cuts off both of their ears and makes grotesque little necklaces out of them that he always wears around his neck. When these ears start to rot, he moves on to another ambush to obtain new ‘trophies’.

Nitstik Snotnose is one of the goblin shamans of the Рашкрадальнікі clan. He serves a dual purpose, his main mission being to go into the forest in search of possible supplies, but he always ends up hearing rumors... such as those of a caravan that could be raided or a war party sent to hunt them down. Thus, his reports are a valuable source of information.

Sliznab Loonsack is the 'smith' of the Рашкрадальнікі clan. He's not a real smith. His main job is to take all the junk and trash the clan collects and 'repurpose' it to try and create rudimentary weapons or anything else the clan can use. Obviously, he keeps the best designs for himself.

Dagnogg Sicktoof is one of the Рашкрадальнікі clan's wolf breeders. He is also in charge of taming the wolves and teaching the other goblins how to ride them. Although, truth be told, his training consists almost exclusively of kicking them into the breeding grounds and hoping the wolves don't devour them.

Slizgank Snidespit is able to blend into any environment and hide behind the smallest bush or even in tall grass. It can spend hours completely motionless, waiting for an unsuspecting traveler to pass by before it sneaks up and stabs its knife into their neck without making the slightest noise.

Snuffglub Dampfinga is one of the goblin shamans of the Рашкрадальнікі clan. He is rarely seen outside the clan hideout, as he lives deep within it, ensuring that the darkness and humidity are conducive to the mushrooms consumed by the shamans of his clan.

Gitrank Squigbagz is a Nasty Skulker from the Рашкрадальнікі clan. He is an expert in all kinds of weapons, from knives, spears, bows or even throwing weapons. But what he likes most is showing off how good a fighter he is to the rest of his clan members.

Grullin Drizzlesack, the most annoying, repulsive, stinking, and irritating shaman a goblin clan could ever have. If it weren't for his mastery of Da Little Waaagh, he would have been thrown to the bottom of the sea by the claws long ago.

One of the least prestigious goblins in the clan. Such is the contempt for him from the other goblins that he is not even considered for ambush parties. The only job he is forced to do is to row over and over again whenever there is a shipwreck to help other goblins collect the floating cargo. However, if he sees something he likes, he often throws his companion overboard to keep whatever the other has pulled from the sea.

Gibgat Poisonarmz is one of the goblins that the Рашкрадальнікі clan uses to dive and try to search the bottom of the bay for the possible valuable merchandise of the reckless ships that run aground and are shipwrecked in the Manaan’s Tooth.

O’nery Backslider leads the Чырвонае Вока tribe from the ancient dwarven fortress of Karak Ungor on Гара Чырвонае Вока. From his vantage point, he has a view for several leagues around him, and is able to spot enemy armies; such as those of the dwarves, who wish to reclaim their ancestral home, or traveling caravans that they can raid. Occasionally, he also faces hordes of Skaven deep within the fortress, attempting to assault his domain from below.

Grotstik Gunkspit is a night goblin who takes charge of Гара Чырвонае Вока when O’nery Backslider is away or doesn't feel like dealing with it.It is often seen patrolling the depths of the fortress in search of underground Skaven routes, as long as O’nery does not call him to his presence.
Slitgaz Snotguzzla is the most powerful goblin shaman of the Чырвонае Вока tribe. None of the other shamans can even match Slitgaz's knowledge in Da Little Waaagh with their spells.

Iggrit Slugsmakka is one of the goblin strategists of the Red Eyes tribe. It is not uncommon for him to take advantage of his position to take the shiniest loot from each ambush. Even if that means eliminating one of his minions to get it.

The Чырвонае Вока tribe's chief squig breeder, Grotzat Toadtongue always has his spike ready to tease his hungry squigs and make them even more ferocious when the time comes. Grotzat is one lucky goblin, as he has yet to lose a limb while doing his work... yet.

Stizlik Drizzlesmakka is the leader of the Чырвонае Вока clan's hunting party. According to him, anything goes to fill the goblins' larders, from the animals of the surrounding forests to the occasional unsuspecting intruder.

Snufflak Shroomgobba is a master ambusher who spends most of his time setting traps on the paths that cross the mountains. Once a victim falls into one, his loud squeals of joy alert the rest of the clan to feast and steal his wares.

Shubgur Lurchsponge is a ‘goblin’ only because he claims to be. The other goblins believe him since none of them have paid him enough attention, but if one of them were to look closely, he does have certain traits that could mistake him for a gnoblar. But the Чырвонае Вока tribe doesn't care. Either way, he is a member of the clan.

Naffrunk Venomsplatta is one of the goblins who watch the inner reaches of the fortress for Skaven, often feeding on them. Unfortunately, the warpstone that was abundant in the skaven's body has passed into his body now, affecting his mind and causing him to act erratically (even for a goblin).
Snozzsnit Gloomskuttle is one of the strongest shamans of the Red Eyes tribe. He rarely leaves the depths of the fortress, spending his time hunting Skaven and experimenting on them.

Snuffnank Gunkbelly is an average shaman of the Чырвонае Вока tribe. Despite not being as experienced as other shamans such as Snozzsnit or Slitgaz, he knows perfectly how to 'entertain' his superiors in order to climb the social ladder.

Stogwonk Mothskuttle is a born fighter. He is always willing to fight other goblins and has always emerged victorious, earning him the title of 'the strongest goblin of the Чырвонае Вока tribe'. Despite this, his strength is still insignificant when compared to an average individual from any other race in the old world.

Ragga the Red is a cunning Night Goblin who thrives on ambushes in the full light of day, a rarity among his kind. Most Night Goblins loathe the sun, skulking deep within the dark places of the world. Yet Ragga has turned that fear on its head. He knows that the Dwarf patrols and merchant caravans travelling through Пікавы Перавал often feel safest under the noonday sun. It is precisely then that his warband strikes. Ragga's hatred for daylight is eclipsed only by his love of blood, used in strange rituals and mixed into foul fungus brew to enhance its potency. He and his band cloak themselves in shadowy hoods and blackened robes, yet Ragga himself smears his skin with a clotted mixture of Dwarf blood and cave-mud, believing it shields him from the sun’s touch. Whether this works or he simply endures the pain through madness is unclear as none of his kin dare imitate him. After each ambush, the slain and the wounded are dragged back to the camp, where they are bound and bled slowly into rusted cauldrons, their screams echoing through the crags. The Dwarfs have come to call him Zangrobi, “the Red Goblin” in Khazalid, and his name appears many times in the Dammaz Kron of Карак-Кадрын. King Ungrim himself is said to have sworn a personal oath to see Ragga’s entrails hung from the gates of the hold.

Gorkil is an ambitious Night Goblin warboss, though not the kind to be found in the thick of a fight. He leads from the rear. Far, far at the rear. Under his dubious command, his warband has pillaged countless caravans brave enough to move through Пікавы Перавал. Ever watchful from the shadows, Gorkil has a keen eye for when things are about to turn sour. When a battle seems lost or the enemy proves too resilient, he doesn’t hesitate to scarper, often leaving his lads behind to buy him the time he needs to vanish into the rocks. Cowardice, some might say, but Gorkil calls it 'tactical foresight.'

Snagga rarely strays from the dark, winding caves he calls home, and if he does, it is only under the cloak of deepest night. Unlike most of his kind, it is not the sun he dreads, but being seen at all. So consumed is he by this fear that his mind has splintered; some say he mutters to shadows and lashes out at thin air, convinced he is ever watched by unseen eyes. He emerges only to raid when even the moons are little more than slivers in the sky. Survivors of such night-time assaults whisper of a deranged goblin, ranting and raving as he slaughtered all who dared glance in his direction. Few live to tell the tale, and none forget the madness in his eyes.

Bagmuk is infamous across the tribe for his so-called “famous” Bloodrot Brew, a vile concoction blending whatever alcoholic swill he can scavenge, whether Dwarfen or Goblin in origin, with blood drawn from whatever remains he happens to have at hand. Be it the ichor of a freshly-squeezed Dwarf arm, the pulped juice of a horse’s leg, the clotted mess of a crushed human torso, or, the thick gore squeezed from a heap of Dwarf bodies, stomped flat into a red paste by over-eager trolls, Bagmuk considers it all fair game for fermentation. He roams far from the caves in search of “ingredients,” raiding travellers and border patrols alike to fuel his grotesque brewing experiments. Of late, he has developed a particular fondness for what he now calls “Bile Brew”,a noxious spirit made by mixing alcohol with the corpse-bile of the undead. Driven by this new obsession, Bagmuk has begun leading raids deeper into the east, ever eager to sample fresh sources for his revolting mixtures.

Snagrat is rarely still, constantly prowling the dark tunnels and narrow passes in search of Dwarfen caravans, patrols, or wandering Skaven scouts. For reasons even other gobbos find strange, Snagrat harbours an intense hatred for hair of any kind. Dwarf beards and ratmen fur are the worst offenders,just the sight of them sends him into a snarling frenzy, clawing and slashing at the hairy foe until nothing remains but blood and silence. Wolves and trophy hides just about get a pass, barely, but truth be told, Snagrat would rather see the lot of it go up in flames.

Daggit is the younger brother of Nobber, by mere seconds, and the pair are rarely seen without arguing over the best way to deal with the “twiggies in da west.” While Nobber favours simply killing the Elves outright, Daggit insists it’s better to loot their lands, torch their groves, and leave nothing worth returning to.

Nobber is the elder brother of Daggit, by mere seconds, and the two are often at odds over the best way to trouble the “twiggies in da west.” It was Nobber who first stumbled upon the hidden paths leading into the Elven lands, and he wasted no time in sharing the secret with his brother, eager to cause as much trouble as possible amongst the tree-lovers. Nobber believes it is better to kill the elves outright, instead of worrying about their lands. Elves can’t return if they’re dead after all.

Digga Erfglobba is a lowly Goblin with a peculiar interest in digging holes. This and his short stature have led to the other Goblin calling him a ‘Stunty’, the orcish word for Dwarf, and a nasty rumour that he actually spawned from a cluster of snotling mushrooms. You can almost spot some thin beard hairs on his chin… Despite, or more probably because of all this, he was made a minor Boss of his tribe, as every Boss needs someone to look down on among their own peers and in Digga’s case, it is quite literally so.
Mortkin, also known as the 'Black-Iron Reaver,' is a mighty Chaos Lord and king of the Norscans.

Pyucius the Dung Tongued is the current Warlord for the Repugnants of Масянжавая Крэпасьць and is the current herald of the Putrid Blightkings in the Масянжавая Крэпасьць. Pyucius was one of many Chaos warriors who assailed the Масянжавая Крэпасьць long ago during the Great War Against Chaos, who became a half human, half daemonic mutant known as a Putrid Blightking. Although a most revolting and ruthless mutant to the empire, many of the Repugnants believe him to be endearing and a true son of Nurgle, believing him to herald a new wave of rot, death, and rebirth to the Empire of Man.

A frothing reaper of men, Squalm the Rabid is one of the Putrid Blightking champions assisting Pyucius the Dung Tongued in destroying the Empire for the glory of Nurgle. A fairly short and mutated monster of man and somewhat beast, Squalm is more warlord than most of his Nurgle brothers, preferring to destroy everything in his path so Grandfather Nurgle can rebuild from the wastes.

An ever living servant of the Carrion Lord, The Glophelm hails from the far north, well beyond Norsca and far into the Chaos Wastes. No one knows much about this being, only that it cannot speak in a normal tongue to most, mostly due to the fact that the beings face and helm are one. The Glophelm is a monster compared to most men, both in strength and height, and is a fearsome sight on the field.

Chosen even before birth, Malarius of Обельштайн was born from a human mother whose husband had long since abandoned her. Before his malefic birth, a fly spawn of Bloab Rotspawn, father of all Chosen of Nurgle, had infected Malarius’ mother Elke. Unbeknownst to her, a plague child was brewing in her womb. After Elke’s passing from the disease of her own child, the nauseating half human half daemon spawn that emerged from her was sent far into the forest, where it would be found by Bleboth the Blighted Apothecary. Bleboth would mold the sickly child to become a sickening brute of a warrior.

Bleboth the Blighted Apothecary is the head apothecary for the Putrid Blightkings in Масянжавая Крэпасьць, finding ways to concoct plagues and disease to spread through the Empire. Indeed, Bleboth is one of the few Blight Kings in Масянжавая Крэпасьць who knows how to bend the Winds of Magic to his will, specifically the wind of Dhar. Although he prefers to concoct plagues in secret within the Citadel of Масянжавая Крэпасьць, he will most joyously leave the confines of the slimy palace to experiment on his enemies.

Woerot the Tainted is a champion of Nurgle. He guards the Brasskeep against sneaky invaders like the skaven. When catching skaven he will use their body as vessel for new diseases to honor his god. By doing this he gets many blessings from Nurgle for his body is bloated and covered in poxes.
Dreadlord of Kassna Kor

Ungrol Four-Horn, also known as Blackheart, Hornsthief, and the Spurned One, is a two-headed, mutant Ungor and budding Bray-Shaman who is consumed with bitterness and spite. There is no more hateful a creature in the Old World, for he has been cast out of the ranks of both Men and Beastmen.
ROOOOOAAAAAAAARRRGGHHHHGH!!!' -Thrugg

It is said that Bertrand, now known as the 'Brigand', was originally a poor peasant in the feudal domain of Bergerac, in the deeply forested heartland of Bretonnia. All was well until the old Baron de Bergerac went off on the Grail Quest and never returned. This was a long time ago. While the old Baron was away, Orcs came out of the forest and ravaged the entire domain. The situation for the peasants was increasingly desperate. Bertrand soon assumed the leadership of the peasants. While the nobles shut themselves up in the castle, he organised the villagers. They practiced archery every day until they were all marksmen. Bertrand made sure that every approach to the village was watched, and soon the Orc raiders were being driven off empty handed. Sometimes they were even pursued into the forest, the villagers felling the Orcs as they fled.

Gui le Gros is a member of the Лучнікі Бержэрака under Bertrand the Brigand. A Bretonnian commoner fighting for the people like himself, ordinary Bretonnian peasants oppressed by their lords. On some occasions, he has also been known to ally with them in a fight against the common enemy, like Orcs & Goblins or Hordes of Chaos. He is known to be an excellent orator, as his speeches raise great quantities of people to arms wherever he treads, often making crucial difference between victory and defeat. He also never asks much for his services. In fact, just some fine food and drink will be enough to satisfy him, a fact that only adds to his popularity and reputation.

Hugo le Petit is a member of the Лучнікі Бержэрака under Bertrand the Brigand. Renowned for his immense strength and size, he is the right hand man of Bertrand.He carries a vast staff and huge longbow whose arrows are more like javelins

Sir Geg, or mostly known as 'The Peasant Knight', is the first and only peasant ever knighted in the lands of Bretonnia. Although many lords and ladies see the brawny peasant as no more than what he was born as, Sir Geg was gifted the Grail from The Lady, and supped from the grail afore many of his fellow peasants. Now, sir Geg claims the lands of Уэйнфліт as his own, protecting the poor and innocent with his life.

Sir Tristan the Troubadour is a Bretonnian questing knight and minstrel who regularly travels the length and breadth of the whole kingdom. Despite not yet ascending into the holiness of the Lady, many regard Tristan with the same respect as they would a grail knight. Into battle he rides, singing all the while to inspire both himself and those around him; it's said his swordwork is as beautiful as the songs he sings or plays on his lute.

Jules le Jongleur is a jester, a mimic and the sworn companion of Tristan le Troubadour the singing knight. When Tristan went on his grail quest Jules begged him if he could join him. Tristan agreed with this and the two have been on adventure ever since. Over the years of Tristan's quest, the mismatched duo have seen many strange things and battled countless terrible foes, ranging from the diminutive but vicious Goblin warlords, To the big beastman herd leaders. Jules isn't a fighter but he is very good in distracting the enemy to give Tristan a advantage. It is said that jules can mimic every existing creature in the old world a skill not many posses.

The ingenious Borgio the Besieger, the Prince of Miragliano, originally employed the famous regiment of Besiegers, as a special siege unit of crossbowmen during times of war. Borgio wanted marksmen who could pick off defenders on the walls at close range in the face incoming enemy missiles, hold ramparts against assaults, provide missile support for their main infantry, sappers, miners, siege towers, and if need be, stand their ground against enemy units sallying out of the besieged fortress. Bragnaza's troops soon proved their worth in Borgio's many sieges and turned out to be equally good as a rearguard in open battle.

The most common tales revolving around Richter Kreugar's tragic curse tell of a young mercenary captain, proud, talented, and ruthless. He hired out his services freely, uncaring who he fought for as long as the price was right. Centuries ago in the history of the Old World, Richer was said to have allied with a powerful Necromancer, aiding him in his diabolical campaign against the Empire, terrorizing the heavily forested area around Вольфэнбург.
Stiffen the Sinews, summon the blood, disguise fair nature with hard - favoured rage and imitate the actions of the Leopard!

We are Voland's Venators... The Drunken Calvary!... We cannot march, we cannot fight... What wretched knights are we!... But when we see the enemy... Our heads are very clear... We Charge straight for their baggage camp... and liberate their gears!

JOIN US....are you good enough to fight alongside the best warriors in the world?.....THE MARKSMEN OF MIRAGLIANO ARE LOOKING FOR MORE MEN TO JOIN THEIR RANKS!.....if you can handle a crossbow and a life of adventure come to the Merry Archer at noon!.....WE HIT THE RIGHT SPOT EVERY TIME!

No, they didn't look dangerous, more like a bunch of rich kids out to show off in their new armour. Very flashy they were, all gems and silk. We'll have a bit of fun, we thought. Easy pickings, we thought. Well anyone can make a mistake. Poor old captain Malvino, last mistake he ever made...
